title: The LIVE badge is now actually live
notes: Discussions now show a “LIVE” badge automatically when several members are reading at the same time — driven by who's actually on the page. It appears and clears on its own and refreshes every few seconds without a reload.

changelog.text: The “LIVE” badge on a discussion is now driven by real concurrent viewers (via lightweight heartbeats), refreshed on the forum without a reload.
